gaps.title: Container Water Distribution & Sensor Placement
gaps.neededVisual: A dedicated container cross-section showing vertical and horizontal moisture gradients, emitter wetting pattern, representative versus biased sensor positions, root occupancy and how one probe can miss dry or saturated zones.

gaps.title: Irrigation Catch Test & Distribution Uniformity
gaps.neededVisual: A purpose-built irrigation audit diagram showing catch cups across a zone, beginning/middle/end pressure locations, raw delivery volumes, low-quarter sampling and a clearly defined distribution-uniformity calculation.

gaps.title: Dryback Curve: Drainage, Daytime & Overnight Segments
gaps.neededVisual: A time-series diagram that labels post-irrigation peak, drainage, daytime decline, last irrigation, lights-off, overnight decline and next-day pre-irrigation while distinguishing absolute VWC change from relative percent change.

gaps.title: Runoff, Leaching Fraction & Salt Mass Balance
gaps.neededVisual: A container water-and-salt balance diagram separating applied solution, retained pore water, preferential flow, drainage collection, evaporation and plant uptake while showing why runoff is not a direct biopsy of the entire rhizosphere.

gaps.title: EC, Salinity, Osmotic Availability & PPM Scales
gaps.neededVisual: A dedicated chemistry diagram showing EC as total ionic conductivity, rising osmotic constraint as dissolved salts concentrate, and why 500-scale and 700-scale meter ppm displays can differ for the same measured EC.

gaps.title: Input pH, Root-Zone pH, Alkalinity & Buffering
gaps.neededVisual: A chemistry flow diagram separating current input pH from alkalinity and buffer capacity, then showing how roots, fertilizer form, lime, irrigation fraction and stored chemistry can drive root-zone pH away from the input value.

gaps.title: Runoff, Pour-Through, Slurry & Extract Sampling
gaps.neededVisual: A side-by-side root-zone testing diagram showing what runoff, pour-through, slurry or dilution extract and saturated-media extract actually sample, including dilution/timing differences and a warning not to exchange method-specific reference ranges.
